coverTitle:
Five Prayers
For The One
Who's Always Caring
coverDek: For the exhaustion nobody sees because you're too busy holding everyone else together - five prayers for the caregiver who needs care too.

points.hook: Lord, I love them, and I'm exhausted - both are true at once.
paragraphs: I smile at the nurses, I answer the same question for the hundredth time, and nobody asks how I'm doing in the middle of all of it. Some nights my heart feels so overwhelmed I don't know where to put it down. Lead me to a rock higher than this exhaustion.
points.verseText: “From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.”

points.hook: I decree: I will not run out before this season does.
paragraphs: What I'm giving to care for them is not pulled from empty - You are the strength I draw from, not the strength I'm running out of. In Jesus' name, I have enough, because You never faint and You never grow weary.
points.verseText: “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.”

points.hook: Lord, my body has been running on adrenaline longer than it should.
paragraphs: My back aches from the lifting, my eyes burn from the nights I keep listening down the hall, and I've forgotten what a full night's sleep feels like. Be the strength of my heart when my own strength gives out.
points.verseText: “My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.”

points.hook: We see the one everyone calls for updates but nobody calls just to ask how they're holding up.
paragraphs: We're not leaving you to carry this by yourself - we're bringing the meal, sitting the shift, praying the prayer you're too tired to pray tonight. This burden gets to be shared, not just updated on.
points.verseText: “Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.”

points.hook: Child, who has been taking care of you while you take care of them?
paragraphs: I noticed the meals you skipped and the tears you cried in the car before you walked back in with a smile. The way you carry them is the way I have been carrying you the whole time - and I'm not setting you down.
points.verseText: “And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.”

cta.closingLine: If this spoke to you, let's stay connected.
